title: imap session: protocol state machine using imap-next
description: Create crates/imap/src/session.rs. Per-connection session. pub enum SessionState { Unauthenticated, Authenticated { username: String }, Selected { username: String, mailbox: String, readonly: bool } }. pub struct ImapSession { state: SessionState, server: imap_next::server::Server<tokio_rustls::server::TlsStream<tokio::net::TcpStream>>, stores: Arc<ImapStores>, pool: Arc<SqlitePool> }. Algorithm: (1) build Greeting = Response::Status(Status::ok(None, None, 'usenet-ipfs-imap ready')); (2) create imap_next::server::Server with greeting and default options; (3) loop: call server.next() via stream, match event: GreetingSent => continue, CommandReceived(cmd) => dispatch(cmd), CommandAuthenticateReceived => handle_authenticate(), IdleCommandReceived => handle_idle(), IdleDoneReceived => exit idle, ResponseSent => continue, error => break. Defensive: command_timeout_secs enforced via tokio::time::timeout around server.next().
